info.title: COHO Public API 1.1 — Maintenance subset
info.description:
**Current integrator API.** Use `/v1.1/public/*` for new integrations and when migrating from v1.0 (`/v1/public/*` or `/v1.0/public/*`).

This OpenAPI document is the authoritative contract. Operations are marked **Stable** for production integrator use.

Coming from v1.0? Follow the [v1.0 → v1.1 migration guide](https://api.coho.life/docs/public-api/v1.0-to-v1.1) (sunset **6 October 2026 UTC**). Switch documents in Scalar to **COHO Public API 1.0** only while comparing deprecated operations.

**PATCH:** request bodies are ordinary JSON objects with optional properties (a partial update). They are not RFC 6902 JSON Patch operation arrays. Send `Content-Type: application/json`.

get.description: Retrieve the organisation maintenance category tree. Use category GUIDs when creating a maintenance issue or converting a conversation to a maintenance issue. Disabled categories are omitted.

Retrieve a paginated list of maintenance issues. Each item includes guid (for routes) and jobNumber (human identifier). Optional propertyReference, propertyReferences, and propertyTags restrict results to matching properties (property and building tags; room tags do not match). Unknown references or tags return an empty page.

parameters.name: propertyReferences
parameters.description: Restrict to these property references. Combined with propertyReference when both are supplied.

parameters.name: propertyTags
parameters.description: Restrict to properties matching these property or building tags. Room tags do not match.

post.description: Create a maintenance issue. Returns both guid and jobNumber. Optional maintenanceCategoryGuid links the issue to a category from ListMaintenanceCategoriesV11.

get.description: Retrieve a maintenance issue by its guid.

post.description: Create a maintenance issue from an existing conversation and re-link that conversation as the manager/housemates thread. Requires both the maintenance.write and conversations.write scopes on the API key.

patch.description: Mark a maintenance issue as completed.

post.description: Add a file on a maintenance issue. Upload via GET /v1.1/public/files/presigned-upload-url, then pass FilePostModel with key. Query: managerOnly.

parameters.name: managerOnly
parameters.description: Is the file only viewable by the manager

post.description: Attach files already on one of your maintenance issues to another issue without re-uploading. Pass file references (not upload keys). Query: managerOnly.

parameters.name: managerOnly
parameters.description: Are the files only viewable by the manager

get.description: Retrieve the history log for a maintenance issue, newest first.

post.description: Add a manual note to a maintenance issue history log.

guid.description: Unique identifier for this history item

filename.description: Optional display name for the file in COHO. Defaults to originalFilename when omitted.

originalFilename.description: Name of the uploaded file, including its extension (used to determine the file type). Required for new files.

MaintenanceIssueCompleteAwaitingDecision.description: What to do next: complete, or wait for something

guid.description: Stable machine identifier for this maintenance issue. Use in route paths for detail and write operations.

jobNumber.description: Human-readable job number shown in the product UI (for example M0001).

MaintenanceDetailedStatuses.description: External status, shown to the tenants or the owner on their respective dashboards

MaintenancePublicStatuses.description: External status, shown to the tenants or the owner on their respective dashboards

maintenanceCategoryGuid.description: Optional maintenance category GUID from ListMaintenanceCategoriesV11. When set, the issue is linked to that category and organisation category overrides (for example auto-assign supplier) are applied.

guid.description: Stable machine identifier for this maintenance category. Use when creating or converting maintenance issues.

hierarchy.description: Ancestor path excluding this category (for example "Bathroom / En-Suite > Sink & Taps"). Null for top-level categories.

BearerAuth.description: Create an API user on your COHO organisation to get that API key
